en.headline: Social enterprise Agape Garden to close Tseung Kwan O shop in early December
en.dek: The operator said the Housing Department notified it that the shop space would be reclaimed, following a similar closure of its Shek Kip Mei branch last year.
body: Social enterprise Agape Garden said on Saturday that it had received written notice from the Housing Department reclaiming its shop space in Tseung Kwan O and that the shop would close in early December.

The operator posted on social media that it was announcing the closure with heavy heart. The Tseung Kwan O outlet, which began trial operation in February 2021, is the remaining branch after the Shek Kip Mei restaurant was not renewed and closed in July last year.

Agape Garden has operated as a social enterprise that has distributed free meals to elderly residents and helped collect and pass on cat food. The operator said the Housing Department’s notice required the space for other purposes, bringing the Tseung Kwan O shop to an end in early December.

zh.headline: 社企膳心小館將軍澳店不獲房署續租 12月上旬結業
zh.dek: 營運者稱接獲房屋署書面通知收回舖位，繼去年石硤尾店結業後，這是僅餘分店。
body: 社企「膳心小館」周六在社交平台公布，日前接獲房屋署書面通知要求收回將軍澳舖位，該店將於12月上旬結業。
營運者表示懷着沉重心情與不捨向公眾告別。將軍澳店於2021年2月開始試業，是去年中石硤尾店不獲房屋署續租並於7月結業後僅餘的分店。
膳心小館過往不時向基層長者派發免費飯盒，亦協助收集及轉讓貓糧。營運者指房屋署通知收回舖位作其他用途，令將軍澳店在12月上旬結束營業。
